attchmntText: Prajay Engineers Syndicate Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.Sub: Submission of Unaudited Financial Results (both Standalone and Consolidated) for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30-09-2026.Ref: Reg. 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015- With reference to the above cited subject, we would like to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company in their meeting held on 12-11-2026, have inter-alia considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results (both Standalone and Consolidated) for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30-09-2026.Hence, please find the following documents that are required to be submitted under Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 20151. Un-audited standalone and consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30-09-2026.2. A certified copy of Limited Review Report on standalone Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30-09-2026 by the Statutory Auditors.3. A certified copy of Limited Review Report on consolidated Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30-09-2026 by the Statutory Auditors.The aforesaid results, duly reviewed by the Audit Committee, have been approved and taken on record by the Board of Directors at the just concluded Board Meeting held today i.e. on                           12-11-2026.This is for your information and records.
voiceSummary: Prajay Engineers Syndicate Limited submitted its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 12, 2026. The standalone net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 270.45 lakhs. The half-year net loss was Rs. 661.30 lakhs. The auditor issued a clean review report for both standalone and consolidated results. The report notes that net cash inflow figures were not subjected to review. An emphasis of matter highlights ongoing arbitration proceedings with the Government of Telangana regarding lease and construction agreements. Another emphasis notes the disposal of cases filed by investor companies before the National Company Law Tribunal following a settlement agreement. The company lists subsidiaries including Prajay Holdings Private Limited and associates like Prajay Properties Private Limited.
